# House of Eyeglasses

> Online eyewear store in the United States. Designer eyeglasses frames from 150+ brands, new and in stock, with prescription lenses made to the customer's prescription. Free shipping in the USA, delivered in 5–10 business days. An optician checks every prescription before the lab starts. Unworn non-prescription frames can be returned within 30 days.

Every frame has its own page with brand, model, color code, size in millimetres, price in US dollars and availability. Prices shown are for the frame; prescription lenses are added in four short steps on the frame's page. The site is in English with a Spanish version of every text (EN | ES).

## Guides
- [How to Read an Eyeglass Prescription](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/receta.html): What OD, OS, OU, SPH, CYL, AXIS, ADD, prism and PD mean on your eyeglass prescription, plus a free sign checker that stays on your device.
- [Measure Your PD Online](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/pd.html): Measure your pupillary distance (PD) online with your camera, or with a ruler and a mirror. Free, no app, and no photo leaves your device. The camera measurement runs in the browser with two rulers (the iris and the proportions of the face); it gives the distance PD to about ±2.5 mm for an adult, ±3 mm for a child.
- [Lens Options](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/lentes.html): Compare lens types, materials and coatings, see who each one is for, and find the right lens thickness for your prescription.
- [Find Your Fit: Frame Size Guide](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/talla.html): Work out your frame size from the three numbers on the glasses you own, or measure your face with a card, plus the frame shapes that suit your face.
- [Style Quiz](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/quiz.html): Six quick questions to find the frame shapes, materials, colors and lenses that suit you. No sign-up needed.
- [Glasses for Your Face Shape](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/face-shape-guide.html): How to choose glasses for your face shape: round, square, heart, oval or long, with the frame shapes that flatter each one and every shape in stock. One page per face shape: round, square, heart, oval and long.

## Eye care guides (general information with links to their official sources: FDA, AAO, AOA, NEI, FTC, CDC; they do not replace an eye exam, and the store does not do eye exams)
- [Signs You Need Glasses](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/signs-you-need-glasses.html): Blurry vision, squinting, eye strain, headaches, glare or halos, trouble at night: what each sign points to, when not to wait, how to get a prescription.
- [How Often Should You Get an Eye Exam?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/how-often-eye-exam.html): How often to get an eye exam by age and risk, per the American Optometric Association and the American Academy of Ophthalmology, and when to go sooner.
- [How Long Is an Eyeglass Prescription Valid?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/how-long-is-a-prescription-valid.html): Usually one or two years, set by state law and your eye doctor. Where to find the date, and your right to a copy under the FTC Eyeglass Rule.
- [Nearsighted vs Farsighted](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/nearsighted-vs-farsighted.html): A minus SPH means nearsighted, a plus SPH farsighted. What each one is, how presbyopia and ADD fit in, real examples and which lenses to choose.
- [Glasses for Astigmatism](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/glasses-for-astigmatism.html): What CYL and AXIS mean, which lenses suit astigmatism (single vision, progressive, high-index, anti-reflective) and how to pick a frame that fits.
- [How Much Do Prescription Glasses Cost?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/prescription-glasses-cost.html): What prescription glasses cost online: the frame price plus the lenses, with today’s lens prices and three example totals. Free U.S. shipping.
- [Contacts vs Glasses: Pros, Cons, Cost](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/contacts-vs-glasses.html): Contacts vs glasses: what each does well, the fitting and care contacts need, and how costs compare over time. Facts from the FDA, FTC and eye doctors.
- [Do You Still Need Glasses After LASIK?](https://houseofeyeglasses.com/glasses-after-lasik.html): Do you still need glasses after LASIK? Often for reading after 40, sometimes for a small leftover prescription or night driving. What the FDA says.
